articles.title: NASA loading liquid hydrogen aboard Artemis 2 rocket in unannounced test
articles.summary: NASA is loading liquid hydrogen aboard its Space Launch System moon rocket at the Kennedy Space Center on Thursday for an unpublicized but crucial test of the repairs made to a leaky umbilical that derailed a countdown rehearsal on Feb. 2.
